name: Exterior Foundation Alkali-Resistant Primer
intent: Alkali-resistant primer mandatory on ALL new foundation (pH 12-14). Single coat. 3 application methods.
doctrine: Alkali-resistant primer (e.g., SW Loxon) mandatory on ALL new foundation. pH 12-14 requires chemical resistance. Oil-based primer PROHIBITED (saponification). Enables 7-day accelerated coating vs 28-day cure. Foundation type modifier (CMU=1.15x) applies.
